t: Two conditions on the same promise
a: مَنْ يَقُمْ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
p: Man yaqum laylata-l-qadri īmānan wa-ḥtisāban ghufira lahu mā taqaddama min dhanbih
m: Whoever stands the Night of Decree out of faith and seeking the reward is forgiven what has gone before of his sin.
